results.title: Meta bets on local AI with Muse Glimmer 30B for PCs and Macs
results.description: Meta has launched Muse Glimmer 30B, an open-weight AI model built for local agents, coding, tool use and multimodal tasks. The model posts strong benchmark scores against Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B and can be compressed to under 20GB for high-end consumer hardware.
